sinopsis.es: Este documental musical sobre una superseguidora de Our Lady Peace la acompaña en la gira canadiense del trigésimo aniversario de la banda, y luce una banda sonora original de Lesley Barber (Bonjour Tristesse) y arreglos orquestales de Eric Rosse (Little Earthquakes, de Tori Amos).
sinopsis.en: This music documentary on an Our Lady Peace superfan follows her on the band’s 30th anniversary Canadian tour, and boasts an original score by Lesley Barber (Bonjour Tristesse, TIFF ’24), and orchestral arrangements by Eric Rosse (Tori Amos’ Little Earthquakes).
